|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Twilight Is Upon Me (V)]] (version 3 of 3). It is the current text. * '''Original''' ([[Twilight Is Upon Me (V)]]): the card image documented in the repository (1 October 2023)<ref name="ht-2494181">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/2494181434fdfa411310a5b0e0d0aa18ef8b64de/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Light/hires/twilightisuponme.png as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (current publisher endpoint: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual22-Light/large/twilightisuponme.gif res.starwarsccg.org]; may serve a later printing) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/2494181434fdfa411310a5b0e0d0aa18ef8b64de 2494181] “Set 22”, 1 October 2023.</ref> prints: “If His Destiny on table, deploy on table. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Luke to same battleground as Prophecy Of The Force. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-867258b">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/867258b968f0fccc370675c2054109eabd4d35f8 swccg-card-json commit 867258b] “Set 22” (1 October 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Twilight Is Upon Me (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; creation metadata 6 October 2023).</ref>, page 4, file created 6 October 2023: “If His Destiny on table, deploy on table. Unless Wokling on table, your total Force generation is +1. Once per turn, may ▼ a mobile docking bay. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Luke to same battleground as Prophecy Of The Force. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Twilight Is Upon Me (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Twilight Is Upon Me”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Twilight Is Upon Me (V)]] (published 2 October 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Twilight Is Upon Me]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the errata card image (29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Light/hires/twilightisuponme.png as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (current publisher endpoint: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual22-Light/large/twilightisuponme.gif res.starwarsccg.org]; may serve a later printing) in commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata.</ref> prints: “If His Destiny on table, deploy on table. Your personal Force generation = 2. Once per turn, may ▼ a mobile docking bay. Your total power everywhere is +1 for each [Endor] or [Death Star II] battleground you occupy (limit +2). [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-e1137c3">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/e1137c35d73827551e0f70f68c2e8da6ea8beb6a swccg-card-json commit e1137c3] “More cards and fixes” (15 January 2025) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' “Unless Wokling on table, your total Force generation is +1.” became “Your personal Force generation = 2.” (and the card gained the Personal Force icon); the once-per-game move-phase relocation of Luke was replaced by “Your total power everywhere is +1 for each [Endor] or [Death Star II] battleground you occupy (limit +2).” The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
